title: OutdoorSessionEntry
description: One outdoor climbing session (one crag of one day) as stored in outdoor_logs. Contract with climb-watch (tools/pull.py). The runtime checks live in backend/api/models.py (request models) and backend/engine/outdoor_log.validate_outdoor_entry; test_a324_rope_role_aid.py keeps this schema aligned with them. A324: attempts carry rope_role (absent = lead) and result 'aid' (A0).

log_version.description: outdoor.v1 logs predate the A225 optional fields and stay valid; new logs are outdoor.v2.

spot_id.description: Reference to outdoor_spots[].id (optional, for saved spots)

spot_name.description: Name of the crag / bouldering area. A day can hold one entry per crag (B341); (date, spot_name) is the key (B401).

day_type.description: A225 (outdoor.v2): the kind of day, keys the C241 strategy catalog.

conditions.description: Free-form conditions: the weather auto-fill (A225) stores its whole payload (wind, humidity, dew_point, feels_like, …). Only temperature and condition_band are checked.

name.description: One route per pitch on a multi-pitch: «Route (Crag) – L1…Ln».

grade.description: Grade in Font or French scale

rest_seconds.description: A227: rest before the first burn

climb_seconds.description: A227: on-the-wall time of the first burn

result.description: sent = clean to the top; fell = did not reach the top; topped_out = top with rests on the rope (B393); aid = top pulling on the gear, A0 (A324, rope only: on a boulder the backend stores it as fell). Only 'sent' with rope_role lead (or absent) is a send.

rope_role.description: A324: who was on the sharp end. Absent = lead (every pre-A324 log); the backend stores lead as absent and drops the field on a boulder. Spelling is exact: 'toprope', never 'top_rope' / 'tr'.

logged_at.description: A241: client-stamped end of the burn, ISO 8601 UTC

energy_level.description: Free text (no enum enforced by the API)

overall_feeling.description: Free text (no enum enforced by the API)

load_ref_grade.description: B394: athlete's lead max redpoint when the log was written (logs from 2026-10-17). Selects the relative load formula; absent on older logs. An edit keeps it.
